resources.string: "LOCK_* name together with the DESSMANN registered address prefix F8:AA:B3 identifies a door-lock radio. The address-like manufacturer block is not a registered company identifier. Model and lock state are unknown."
"GR-AC_* name and SIG company identifier 0D23 identify a Gree air-conditioner radio. The name suffix is not a verified retail model. No temperature or operating state is decoded."

"BOLOLO-* advertised name points to the Bololo smart feeding appliance family. The advertisement does not distinguish a sterilizer, formula maker or another feeding appliance, or expose its operating state."
"UTRAO_KH_Ultra_* advertised name claims the KH Ultra aquarium alkalinity tester family. The suffix is a device code, not a KH reading. No water-quality measurement is decoded."
"The exact TAPE LIGHTS advertised name suggests a Bluetooth tape-light controller. Brand, model, brightness, color and power state remain unknown. The address prefix does not prove a Xerox product."

"JoyLink name together with JD-assigned service FE70 identifies a JoyLink ecosystem radio. This platform is shared by different appliances; the advertisement does not identify an exact product or operating state."
